segments.src: ## A Sharper Enforcement Push Ripples Through the Job Site
segments.tr: ## 단속 강화의 물결이 작업 현장으로 밀려들다

segments.src: Builders, farm operators and food processors across the country say they are feeling the effects of a stepped-up federal immigration enforcement effort that, according to multiple news reports, has pushed U.S.
segments.tr: 전국의 건축업자, 농장 경영자, 식품 가공업자들은 여러 언론 보도에 따르면 미국

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) field offices toward a steep increase in daily arrest targets — with some accounts citing a goal in the range of roughly 3,000 arrests per day nationwide.
segments.tr: 이민세관단속국(ICE) 현장 사무소가 하루 체포 목표치를 대폭 늘리도록 압박받고 있는 강화된 연방 이민 단속 노력의 영향을 체감하고 있다고 말합니다. 일부 보도에서는 전국적으로 하루에 약 3,000명을 체포하는 목표를 언급하기도 했습니다.

segments.src: The precise figures have not been independently verified by all outlets and vary depending on the source, but the broader trend described by employers, labor groups and immigration attorneys is consistent: worksite enforcement activity has intensified noticeably in 2026 compared with prior years.
segments.tr: 정확한 수치는 모든 매체에서 독자적으로 검증되지 않았으며 출처에 따라 다르지만, 고용주, 노동 단체, 이민 변호사들이 묘사하는 전반적인 추세는 일치합니다. 즉, 2026년에는 이전 해에 비해 작업장 단속 활동이 눈에 띄게 강화되었습니다.

segments.src: For industries that have long relied on immigrant labor — construction, agriculture, meatpacking and food processing chief among them — the shift is being described less as a single dramatic event and more as a steady drain.
segments.tr: 이민자 노동력에 오랫동안 의존해 온 산업(건설, 농업, 육가공, 식품 가공업이 대표적)의 경우, 이러한 변화는 단발성 사건이라기보다는 지속적인 노동력 유출로 묘사되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Contractors report crews arriving short-handed.
segments.tr: 계약업체들은 일손이 부족한 상태로 현장에 도착하는 작업자들에 대해 보고합니다.

segments.src: Farm operators describe fields left unharvested.
segments.tr: 농장 경영자들은 수확되지 못한 채 방치된 들판을 묘사합니다.

segments.src: Processing plants say they are running reduced shifts.
segments.tr: 가공 공장들은 교대 근무를 축소하여 운영하고 있다고 말합니다.

segments.src: None of this is easily reduced to a single headline number, but the cumulative effect on day-to-day operations is what business owners say concerns them most.
segments.tr: 이 중 어느 것도 하나의 주요 헤드라인 수치로 쉽게 축소될 수는 없지만, 일상적인 운영에 미치는 누적 효과가 사업주들이 가장 우려하는 부분이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## Why Construction and Agriculture Are Especially Exposed
segments.tr: ## 건설업과 농업이 특히 취약한 이유

segments.src: Both sectors share a structural feature that makes them sensitive to enforcement swings: a workforce that is disproportionately foreign-born, including a share of workers without full legal work authorization.
segments.tr: 두 부문은 단속의 변화에 민감하게 반응하게 만드는 구조적 특징을 공유하고 있습니다. 즉, 완전한 합법적 취업 자격이 없는 노동자의 비율을 포함하여 외국 출신 노동자의 비율이 지나치게 높다는 점입니다.

segments.src: Industry associations have noted for years that domestic labor supply alone has not kept pace with demand in framing crews, roofing, drywall, produce picking and poultry processing — jobs that are physically demanding, often seasonal, and historically difficult to staff at prevailing wages in many regions.
segments.tr: 업계 협회들은 골조 공사, 지붕 공사, 건식벽체 공사, 농산물 수확, 가금류 가공 등 육체적으로 고되고 종종 계절성이 있으며 역사적으로 많은 지역에서 통상적인 임금으로는 인력을 구하기 어려웠던 직종에서 국내 노동력 공급만으로는 수요를 따라가지 못했다고 수년 동안 지적해 왔습니다.

segments.src: When enforcement activity rises at a job site or packing facility, the impact is rarely limited to the individuals directly affected.
segments.tr: 작업장이나 포장 시설에서 단속 활동이 증가할 때, 그 영향이 직접적인 영향을 받는 개인에게만 국한되는 경우는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Contractors describe having to pause projects to reassign work, renegotiate subcontracts, or slow timelines.
segments.tr: 계약업체들은 작업을 재배치하거나, 하도급 계약을 재협상하거나, 일정을 늦추기 위해 프로젝트를 일시 중단해야 한다고 설명합니다.

segments.src: Farm groups warn that a labor gap during a harvest window can mean crops left in the field, since produce cannot simply wait for a replacement crew the way other industries can absorb a delay.
segments.tr: 농업 단체들은 다른 산업에서는 지연을 감수할 수 있는 것과 달리 농산물은 대체 작업팀을 기다려 줄 수 없기 때문에 수확기 동안의 노동력 공백은 들판에 작물이 방치되는 것을 의미할 수 있다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## Employers Caught Between Compliance and Continuity
segments.tr: ## 규준 준수와 연속성 사이에서 곤란을 겪는 고용주들

segments.src: Business owners in both sectors emphasize that they are required to verify work eligibility through federal I-9 procedures and, in a growing number of states, E-Verify — and that responsible employers are not knowingly hiring unauthorized workers.
segments.tr: 두 부문의 사업주들은 연방 I-9 절차와 점점 더 많은 주에서 E-Verify를 통해 취업 자격을 확인할 의무가 있으며, 책임감 있는 고용주는 고용 자격이 없는 근로자를 고의로 채용하지 않는다는 점을 강조합니다.

segments.src: Industry representatives argue that the more urgent problem is a mismatch between the scale of enforcement and the absence of an expanded legal pathway for seasonal or year-round labor, leaving employers exposed to disruption regardless of how carefully they screen hires.
segments.tr: 업계 대표들은 더 시급한 문제는 단속의 규모와 계절성 또는 연중 상시 노동력을 위한 확대된 합법적 경로의 부재 사이의 불일치이며, 이로 인해 고용주는 채용 심사를 얼마나 꼼꼼하게 하든 관계없이 혼란에 노출된다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Trade groups representing homebuilders and agricultural producers have renewed calls for Congress to address visa program capacity — including the H-2A program for agricultural workers and proposals to expand similar options for construction — arguing that enforcement without a corresponding labor supply fix simply shifts the shortage rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: 주택 건설업자와 농산물 생산자를 대표하는 무역 단체들은 의회가 비자 프로그램 용량(농업 근로자를 위한 H-2A 프로그램 및 건설을 위한 유사한 옵션 확대 제안 포함)을 해결할 것을 거듭 촉구하며, 상응하는 노동력 공급 해결책 없는 단속은 부족 현상을 해결하는 것이 단순히 이동시킬 뿐이라고 주장합니다.

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## 인적 및 지역사회적 대가

segments.src: Immigration attorneys and worker advocacy organizations point to a separate set of concerns: due process for those detained, family separation when a primary earner is arrested, and the chilling effect on entire communities, where workers — including some with pending legal status applications — may stop showing up to job sites out of fear, regardless of their individual circumstances.
segments.tr: 이민 변호사와 노동자 옹호 단체들은 구금자에 대한 적법 절차, 주 소득원이 체포되었을 때의 가족 해체, 그리고 개별 상황과 관계없이 아직 대기 중인 합법적 신분 신청자를 포함한 노동자들이 두려움 때문에 작업장에 출근하지 않을 수 있는 전체 지역사회에 미치는 위축 효과 등 별도의 우려 사항을 지적합니다.

segments.src: Local officials in some heavily agricultural counties have said school attendance and small-business foot traffic have dipped in the aftermath of visible enforcement operations.
segments.tr: 일부 농업 중심 카운티의 현지 공무원들은 가시적인 단속 작전 이후 학교 출석률과 소상공인 방문객이 감소했다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: ## The Administration's Position
segments.tr: ## 행정부의 입장

segments.src: Federal officials have defended intensified worksite enforcement as a matter of upholding existing immigration law and prioritizing the removal of individuals without legal status, framing it as consistent with directives issued earlier in the current administration's term.
segments.tr: 연방 정부 관료들은 강화된 작업장 단속을 기존 이민법을 유지하고 합법적 신분이 없는 개인의 추방을 우선시하는 문제로 옹호하며, 이를 현재 행정부 임기 초기에 발표된 지침과 일치하는 것으로 규정했습니다.

segments.src: Officials have generally not confirmed a specific numeric daily quota publicly, and characterizations of internal targets have come primarily through anonymous sourcing in press reports, congressional inquiries and statements from advocacy groups tracking enforcement data.
segments.tr: 당국은 일반적으로 구체적인 일일 수치 할당량을 공개적으로 확인하지 않았으며, 내부 목표에 대한 성격 규명은 주로 언론 보도, 의회 질의, 단속 데이터를 추적하는 옹호 단체의 성명에 나오는 익명의 소식통을 통해 이루어졌습니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Several dynamics will shape how this plays out in the months ahead:
segments.tr: 향후 몇 달 동안 이 상황이 어떻게 전개될지 결정할 몇 가지 역학 관계는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Legislative response:** Whether Congress revisits agricultural or construction-specific visa reform amid industry pressure.
segments.tr: - **입법적 대응:** 업계의 압박 속에서 의회가 농업 또는 건설 전용 비자 개정을 재검토할지 여부.

segments.src: - **Regional variation:** Enforcement intensity has reportedly varied significantly by ICE field office and region, meaning the impact on labor supply is uneven across the country.
segments.tr: - **지역별 편차:** ICE 현장 사무소와 지역에 따라 단속 강도가 크게 달랐던 것으로 보이며, 이는 노동력 공급에 미치는 영향이 전국적으로 불균등함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **Litigation:** Civil rights and immigration law organizations have signaled they may challenge specific enforcement actions on procedural grounds.
segments.tr: - **소송:** 시민 자유 및 이민법 단체들은 절차상의 이유로 특정 단속 조치에 이의를 제기할 수 있음을 시사했습니다.

segments.src: - **Price effects:** Economists are watching whether labor shortages in these sectors contribute to upward pressure on construction costs and food prices later in the year.
segments.tr: - **가격 영향:** 경제학자들은 이러한 부문의 노동력 부족이 연말에 건설 비용과 식품 가격의 상승 압력에 기여하는지 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: As with most fast-moving policy stories, official figures, program details and enforcement priorities can shift quickly.
segments.tr: 대부분의 빠르게 변화하는 정책 관련 이야기와 마찬가지로, 공식 수치, 프로그램 세부 정보, 단속 우선순위는 빠르게 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Readers should treat specific numeric claims — including daily arrest targets — as reported estimates rather than confirmed government data until agencies release official statistics.
segments.tr: 독자들은 기관에서 공식 통계를 발표할 때까지 일일 체포 목표를 포함한 구체적인 수치 주장을 확인된 정부 데이터가 아닌 보도된 추정치로 취급해야 합니다.

segments.tr: ## 雇主在合规与业务连续性之间夹缝求生

segments.tr: 代表房屋建筑商和农业生产者的贸易集团再次呼吁国会解决签证计划容量问题——包括针对农业工人的 H-2A 计划以及扩大建筑业类似选择的提案——他们认为，没有相应劳动力供应修复的执法只会转移短缺而不是解决它。

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## 人类与社会的代价

segments.tr: 移民律师和工人倡导组织指出了另一组担忧：被拘留者的正当程序、主要支柱被捕时的家庭分离，以及对整个社区的寒蝉效应——在这些社区中，工人（包括一些有待决合法身份申请的工人）可能会出于恐惧而停止出现在工地上，无论他们的个人情况如何。

segments.src: ## A Sharper Enforcement Push Ripples Through the Job Site
segments.tr: ## एक तेज प्रवर्तन अभियान कार्यस्थल पर असर डाल रहा है

segments.src: Builders, farm operators and food processors across the country say they are feeling the effects of a stepped-up federal immigration enforcement effort that, according to multiple news reports, has pushed U.S.
segments.tr: देश भर के बिल्डर्स, फार्म ऑपरेटर और फूड प्रोसेसर का कहना है कि वे संघीय आव्रजन प्रवर्तन प्रयासों के तेज होने का असर महसूस कर रहे हैं, जो कई समाचार रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, अमेरिकी

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) field offices toward a steep increase in daily arrest targets — with some accounts citing a goal in the range of roughly 3,000 arrests per day nationwide.
segments.tr: इमीग्रेशन एंड कस्टम्स एनफोर्समेंट (ICE) फील्ड ऑफिसों को दैनिक गिरफ्तारी के लक्ष्यों में भारी वृद्धि की ओर ले गया है - कुछ रिपोर्टों में देश भर में प्रतिदिन लगभग 3,000 गिरफ्तारियों के लक्ष्य का हवाला दिया गया है।

segments.src: The precise figures have not been independently verified by all outlets and vary depending on the source, but the broader trend described by employers, labor groups and immigration attorneys is consistent: worksite enforcement activity has intensified noticeably in 2026 compared with prior years.
segments.tr: सटीक आंकड़े सभी समाचार माध्यमों द्वारा स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित नहीं किए गए हैं और स्रोत के आधार पर भिन्न होते हैं, लेकिन नियोक्ताओं, श्रम समूहों और आप्रवासन वकीलों द्वारा वर्णित व्यापक रुझान सुसंगत है: पिछले वर्षों की तुलना में 2026 में कार्यस्थल प्रवर्तन गतिविधि में उल्लेखनीय रूप से तेजी आई है।

segments.src: For industries that have long relied on immigrant labor — construction, agriculture, meatpacking and food processing chief among them — the shift is being described less as a single dramatic event and more as a steady drain.
segments.tr: उन उद्योगों के लिए जो लंबे समय से अप्रवासी श्रम पर निर्भर रहे हैं - जिनमें निर्माण, कृषि, मांस पैकिंग और खाद्य प्रसंस्करण प्रमुख हैं - इस बदलाव को एक नाटकीय घटना के रूप में कम और एक निरंतर कमी के रूप में अधिक वर्णित किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: Contractors report crews arriving short-handed.
segments.tr: ठेकेदारों की रिपोर्ट है कि कर्मी दल कम संख्या में पहुँच रहे हैं।

segments.src: Farm operators describe fields left unharvested.
segments.tr: फार्म ऑपरेटरों का वर्णन है कि खेत बिना कटे छूट रहे हैं।

segments.src: Processing plants say they are running reduced shifts.
segments.tr: प्रसंस्करण संयंत्रों का कहना है कि वे कम शिफ्ट में काम कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: None of this is easily reduced to a single headline number, but the cumulative effect on day-to-day operations is what business owners say concerns them most.
segments.tr: इनमें से किसी भी बात को एक अकेली बड़ी सुर्खी में आसानी से नहीं समेटा जा सकता है, लेकिन दिन-प्रतिदिन के कामकाज पर पड़ने वाला संचयी प्रभाव वह है जिसके बारे में व्यवसाय मालिकों का कहना है कि उन्हें सबसे अधिक चिंता है।

segments.src: ## Why Construction and Agriculture Are Especially Exposed
segments.tr: ## निर्माण और कृषि विशेष रूप से क्यों प्रभावित हैं

segments.src: Both sectors share a structural feature that makes them sensitive to enforcement swings: a workforce that is disproportionately foreign-born, including a share of workers without full legal work authorization.
segments.tr: दोनों क्षेत्रों में एक ऐसी संरचनात्मक विशेषता है जो उन्हें प्रवर्तन के उतार-चढ़ाव के प्रति संवेदनशील बनाती है: एक ऐसा कार्यबल जो असंगत रूप से विदेशी मूल का है, जिसमें पूर्ण कानूनी कार्य प्राधिकरण के बिना काम करने वाले श्रमिकों का एक हिस्सा भी शामिल है।

segments.src: Industry associations have noted for years that domestic labor supply alone has not kept pace with demand in framing crews, roofing, drywall, produce picking and poultry processing — jobs that are physically demanding, often seasonal, and historically difficult to staff at prevailing wages in many regions.
segments.tr: उद्योग संघों ने वर्षों से ध्यान दिया है कि अकेले घरेलू श्रम की आपूर्ति फ्रेमिंग क्रू, छत, ड्राईवॉल, उपज चुनने और पोल्ट्री प्रसंस्करण में मांग के साथ तालमेल नहीं बिठा पाई है - ऐसी नौकरियां जो शारीरिक रूप से मांग वाली, अक्सर मौसमी होती हैं, और ऐतिहासिक रूप से कई क्षेत्रों में प्रचलित मजदूरी पर कर्मचारी रखना मुश्किल होता है।

segments.src: When enforcement activity rises at a job site or packing facility, the impact is rarely limited to the individuals directly affected.
segments.tr: जब किसी कार्यस्थल या पैकिंग सुविधा पर प्रवर्तन गतिविधि बढ़ती है, तो इसका प्रभाव शायद ही कभी सीधे प्रभावित होने वाले व्यक्तियों तक सीमित होता है।

segments.src: Contractors describe having to pause projects to reassign work, renegotiate subcontracts, or slow timelines.
segments.tr: ठेकेदार काम को फिर से सौंपने, उप-अनुबंधों पर फिर से बातचीत करने, या समयसीमा को धीमा करने के लिए परियोजनाओं को रोकने के लिए मजबूर होने का वर्णन करते हैं।

segments.src: Farm groups warn that a labor gap during a harvest window can mean crops left in the field, since produce cannot simply wait for a replacement crew the way other industries can absorb a delay.
segments.tr: कृषि समूहों की चेतावनी है कि कटाई की खिड़की के दौरान श्रम की कमी का मतलब खेत में छोड़ी गई फसलें हो सकती हैं, क्योंकि उपज सिर्फ अन्य उद्योगों की तरह देरी को सहन करने के लिए प्रतिस्थापन दल का इंतजार नहीं कर सकती है।

segments.src: ## Employers Caught Between Compliance and Continuity
segments.tr: ## अनुपालन और निरंतरता के बीच फंसे नियोक्ता

segments.src: Business owners in both sectors emphasize that they are required to verify work eligibility through federal I-9 procedures and, in a growing number of states, E-Verify — and that responsible employers are not knowingly hiring unauthorized workers.
segments.tr: दोनों क्षेत्रों के व्यवसाय मालिकों का जोर इस बात पर है कि उन्हें संघीय I-9 प्रक्रियाओं के माध्यम से काम की पात्रता सत्यापित करने की आवश्यकता है, और बढ़ते राज्यों में, E-Verify - और यह कि जिम्मेदार नियोक्ता जानबूझकर अनधिकृत श्रमिकों को काम पर नहीं रख रहे हैं।

segments.src: Industry representatives argue that the more urgent problem is a mismatch between the scale of enforcement and the absence of an expanded legal pathway for seasonal or year-round labor, leaving employers exposed to disruption regardless of how carefully they screen hires.
segments.tr: उद्योग प्रतिनिधियों का तर्क है कि अधिक जरूरी समस्या प्रवर्तन के पैमाने और मौसमी या साल भर के श्रम के लिए एक विस्तारित कानूनी मार्ग की अनुपस्थिति के बीच का बेमेल है, जिससे नियोक्ता इस बात की परवाह किए बिना व्यवधान के संपर्क में आ जाते हैं कि वे नियुक्तियों की कितनी सावधानी से जांच करते हैं।

segments.src: Trade groups representing homebuilders and agricultural producers have renewed calls for Congress to address visa program capacity — including the H-2A program for agricultural workers and proposals to expand similar options for construction — arguing that enforcement without a corresponding labor supply fix simply shifts the shortage rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: गृह निर्माताओं और कृषि उत्पादकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले व्यापार समूहों ने कांग्रेस से वीजा कार्यक्रम क्षमता को संबोधित करने के लिए अपनी कॉल को नवीनीकृत किया है - जिसमें कृषि श्रमिकों के लिए H-2A कार्यक्रम और निर्माण के लिए समान विकल्पों का विस्तार करने के प्रस्ताव शामिल हैं - यह तर्क देते हुए कि संबंधित श्रम आपूर्ति सुधार के बिना प्रवर्तन केवल कमी को हल करने के बजाय स्थानांतरित करता है।

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## मानवीय और सामुदायिक टोल

segments.src: Immigration attorneys and worker advocacy organizations point to a separate set of concerns: due process for those detained, family separation when a primary earner is arrested, and the chilling effect on entire communities, where workers — including some with pending legal status applications — may stop showing up to job sites out of fear, regardless of their individual circumstances.
segments.tr: आप्रवासन वकील और श्रमिक वकालत संगठन चिंताओं के एक अलग सेट की ओर इशारा करते हैं: हिरासत में लिए गए लोगों के लिए उचित प्रक्रिया, परिवार का अलगाव जब एक प्राथमिक कमाने वाले को गिरफ्तार किया जाता है, और पूरे समुदायों पर ठंडा प्रभाव, जहां श्रमिक - लंबित कानूनी स्थिति आवेदनों वाले कुछ लोगों सहित - व्यक्तिगत परिस्थितियों की परवाह किए बिना डर के कारण कार्य स्थलों पर आना बंद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Local officials in some heavily agricultural counties have said school attendance and small-business foot traffic have dipped in the aftermath of visible enforcement operations.
segments.tr: कुछ भारी कृषि काउंटियों में स्थानीय अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि दृश्यमान प्रवर्तन अभियानों के बाद स्कूल की उपस्थिति और छोटे व्यवसाय के पैदल यातायात में गिरावट आई है।

segments.tr: ## प्रशासन की स्थिति

segments.tr: संघीय अधिकारियों ने मौजूदा आव्रजन कानून को बनाए रखने और कानूनी स्थिति के बिना व्यक्तियों को हटाने को प्राथमिकता देने के मामले के रूप में तीव्र कार्यस्थल प्रवर्तन का बचाव किया है, इसे वर्तमान प्रशासन के कार्यकाल में पहले जारी किए गए निर्देशों के अनुरूप तैयार किया है।

segments.tr: अधिकारियों ने आम तौर पर सार्वजनिक रूप से एक विशिष्ट संख्यात्मक दैनिक कोटा की पुष्टि नहीं की है, और आंतरिक लक्ष्यों के लक्षण मुख्य रूप से प्रेस रिपोर्टों, कांग्रेस के पूछताछ और प्रवर्तन डेटा को ट्रैक करने वाले वकालत समूहों के ब생ों में अज्ञात सोर्सिंग के माध्यम से आए हैं।

segments.tr: Constructores, productores agrícolas y procesadores de alimentos de todo el país afirman estar sintiendo los efectos de un intensificado esfuerzo federal de control migratorio que, según múltiples informes de prensa, ha llevado a las oficinas locales de U.S.

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) field offices toward a steep increase in daily arrest targets — with some accounts citing a goal in the range of roughly 3,000 arrests per day nationwide.
segments.tr: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) a un fuerte incremento en sus objetivos diarios de arrestos, citando algunas versiones una meta cercana a los 3.000 arrestos al día a nivel nacional.

segments.src: The precise figures have not been independently verified by all outlets and vary depending on the source, but the broader trend described by employers, labor groups and immigration attorneys is consistent: worksite enforcement activity has intensified noticeably in 2026 compared with prior years.
segments.tr: Las cifras precisas no han sido verificadas de manera independiente por todos los medios de comunicación y varían según la fuente, pero la tendencia general descrita por empleadores, grupos laborales y abogados de inmigración es constante: la actividad de control en los lugares de trabajo se ha intensificado notablemente en 2026 en comparación con años anteriores.

segments.src: For industries that have long relied on immigrant labor — construction, agriculture, meatpacking and food processing chief among them — the shift is being described less as a single dramatic event and more as a steady drain.
segments.tr: Para los sectores que han dependido durante mucho tiempo de la mano de obra inmigrante —la construcción, la agricultura, el empaque de carne y el procesamiento de alimentos entre los principales— este cambio se describe menos como un único evento dramático y más como un desgaste constante.

segments.src: Contractors report crews arriving short-handed.
segments.tr: Los contratistas reportan que las cuadrillas llegan con personal insuficiente.

segments.src: Farm operators describe fields left unharvested.
segments.tr: Los productores agrícolas describen campos que se quedan sin cosechar.

segments.src: Processing plants say they are running reduced shifts.
segments.tr: Las plantas procesadoras señalan que están operando con turnos reducidos.

segments.src: None of this is easily reduced to a single headline number, but the cumulative effect on day-to-day operations is what business owners say concerns them most.
segments.tr: Nada de esto se reduce fácilmente a una sola cifra titular, pero el efecto acumulativo en las operaciones diarias es lo que los dueños de empresas dicen que les preocupa más.

segments.src: ## Why Construction and Agriculture Are Especially Exposed
segments.tr: ## Por qué la construcción y la agricultura están especialmente expuestas

segments.src: Both sectors share a structural feature that makes them sensitive to enforcement swings: a workforce that is disproportionately foreign-born, including a share of workers without full legal work authorization.
segments.tr: Ambos sectores comparten una característica estructural que los hace sensibles a los cambios en el control migratorio: una fuerza laboral desproporcionadamente nacida en el extranjero, incluida una proporción de trabajadores sin autorización legal completa para trabajar.

segments.src: Industry associations have noted for years that domestic labor supply alone has not kept pace with demand in framing crews, roofing, drywall, produce picking and poultry processing — jobs that are physically demanding, often seasonal, and historically difficult to staff at prevailing wages in many regions.
segments.tr: Las asociaciones del sector han señalado durante años que la oferta de mano de obra nacional por sí sola no ha estado a la par de la demanda en armados de estructuras, techado, paneles de yeso, recolección de frutas y verduras, y procesamiento de aves —empleos que son físicamente exigentes, a menudo de temporada y históricamente difíciles de cubrir con los salarios vigentes en muchas regiones.

segments.src: When enforcement activity rises at a job site or packing facility, the impact is rarely limited to the individuals directly affected.
segments.tr: Cuando la actividad de control aumenta en una obra o planta de empaque, el impacto rara vez se limita a las personas afectadas directamente.

segments.src: Contractors describe having to pause projects to reassign work, renegotiate subcontracts, or slow timelines.
segments.tr: Los contratistas describen tener que pausar proyectos para reasignar tareas, renegociar subcontratos o retrasar los plazos.

segments.src: Farm groups warn that a labor gap during a harvest window can mean crops left in the field, since produce cannot simply wait for a replacement crew the way other industries can absorb a delay.
segments.tr: Los grupos agrícolas advierten que una escasez de mano de obra durante una ventana de cosecha puede significar que los cultivos se queden en el campo, ya que los productos agrícolas no pueden simplemente esperar a una cuadrilla de reemplazo de la forma en que otros sectores pueden absorber un retraso.

segments.src: ## Employers Caught Between Compliance and Continuity
segments.tr: ## Empleadores atrapados entre el cumplimiento y la continuidad

segments.src: Business owners in both sectors emphasize that they are required to verify work eligibility through federal I-9 procedures and, in a growing number of states, E-Verify — and that responsible employers are not knowingly hiring unauthorized workers.
segments.tr: Los dueños de empresas de ambos sectores enfatizan que están obligados a verificar la elegibilidad laboral mediante procedimientos federales del Formulario I-9 y, en un número creciente de estados, E-Verify, y que los empleadores responsables no contratan a sabiendas a trabajadores no autorizados.

segments.src: Industry representatives argue that the more urgent problem is a mismatch between the scale of enforcement and the absence of an expanded legal pathway for seasonal or year-round labor, leaving employers exposed to disruption regardless of how carefully they screen hires.
segments.tr: Los representantes del sector sostienen que el problema más urgente es el desfase entre la escala del control y la falta de una vía legal ampliada para la mano de obra de temporada o continua, lo que deja a los empleadores expuestos a interrupciones independientemente de con cuánta precaución evalúen a las nuevas contrataciones.

segments.src: Trade groups representing homebuilders and agricultural producers have renewed calls for Congress to address visa program capacity — including the H-2A program for agricultural workers and proposals to expand similar options for construction — arguing that enforcement without a corresponding labor supply fix simply shifts the shortage rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: Los grupos gremiales que representan a constructores de viviendas y productores agrícolas han renovado las llamadas al Congreso para abordar la capacidad de los programas de visados —incluido el programa H-2A para trabajadores agrícolas y las propuestas para ampliar opciones similares para la construcción— argumentando que el control sin una solución correspondiente en la oferta de mano de obra simplemente traslada la escasez en lugar de resolverla.

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## El costo humano y comunitario

segments.src: Immigration attorneys and worker advocacy organizations point to a separate set of concerns: due process for those detained, family separation when a primary earner is arrested, and the chilling effect on entire communities, where workers — including some with pending legal status applications — may stop showing up to job sites out of fear, regardless of their individual circumstances.
segments.tr: Los abogados de inmigración y las organizaciones de defensa de los trabajadores señalan un conjunto independiente de preocupaciones: el debido proceso para los detenidos, la separación familiar cuando arrestan al sostén principal del hogar y el efecto disuasorio en comunidades enteras, donde los trabajadores —incluidos algunos con solicitudes de estatus legal pendientes— pueden dejar de presentarse en las obras por miedo, independientemente de sus circunstancias individuales.

segments.src: Local officials in some heavily agricultural counties have said school attendance and small-business foot traffic have dipped in the aftermath of visible enforcement operations.
segments.tr: Funcionarios locales en algunos condados con fuerte actividad agrícola han dicho que la asistencia escolar y el tráfico peatonal en pequeños comercios han disminuido tras las operaciones visibles de control.

segments.src: ## The Administration's Position
segments.tr: ## La postura de la administración

segments.src: Federal officials have defended intensified worksite enforcement as a matter of upholding existing immigration law and prioritizing the removal of individuals without legal status, framing it as consistent with directives issued earlier in the current administration's term.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios federales han defendido la intensificación del control en los lugares de trabajo como una cuestión de hacer cumplir la ley de inmigración existente y dar prioridad a la deportación de personas sin estatus legal, enmarcándolo como algo coherente con las directivas emitidas a principios del mandato de la actual administración.

segments.src: Officials have generally not confirmed a specific numeric daily quota publicly, and characterizations of internal targets have come primarily through anonymous sourcing in press reports, congressional inquiries and statements from advocacy groups tracking enforcement data.
segments.tr: Por lo general, los funcionarios no han confirmado públicamente una cuota diaria numérica específica, y las caracterizaciones de los objetivos internos provienen principalmente de fuentes anónimas en informes de prensa, consultas congresionales y declaraciones de grupos de defensa que hacen seguimiento a los datos de control.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: Several dynamics will shape how this plays out in the months ahead:
segments.tr: Varias dinámicas darán forma a la evolución de esta situación en los próximos meses:

segments.src: - **Legislative response:** Whether Congress revisits agricultural or construction-specific visa reform amid industry pressure.
segments.tr: - **Respuesta legislativa:** Si el Congreso vuelve a examinar la reforma de visados específica para la agricultura o la construcción en medio de la presión del sector.

segments.src: - **Regional variation:** Enforcement intensity has reportedly varied significantly by ICE field office and region, meaning the impact on labor supply is uneven across the country.
segments.tr: - **Variación regional:** Según se informa, la intensidad del control ha variado significativamente según la oficina local de ICE y la región, lo que significa que el impacto en la oferta de mano de obra es desproporcionado en todo el país.

segments.src: - **Litigation:** Civil rights and immigration law organizations have signaled they may challenge specific enforcement actions on procedural grounds.
segments.tr: - **Litigios:** Organizaciones de derechos civiles y de derecho migratorio han señalado que podrían impugnar acciones específicas de control por motivos procesales.

segments.src: - **Price effects:** Economists are watching whether labor shortages in these sectors contribute to upward pressure on construction costs and food prices later in the year.
segments.tr: - **Efectos en los precios:** Los economistas observan si la escasez de mano de obra en estos sectores contribuye a presiones al alza en los costos de construcción y en los precios de los alimentos más adelante en el año.

segments.src: As with most fast-moving policy stories, official figures, program details and enforcement priorities can shift quickly.
segments.tr: Como ocurre con la mayoría de las historias sobre políticas que cambian rápidamente, las cifras oficiales, los detalles del programa y las prioridades de control pueden cambiar con frecuencia.

segments.src: Readers should treat specific numeric claims — including daily arrest targets — as reported estimates rather than confirmed government data until agencies release official statistics.
segments.tr: Los lectores deben considerar las afirmaciones numéricas específicas —incluidos los objetivos diarios de arresto— como estimaciones reportadas y no como datos gubernamentales confirmados hasta que las agencias publiquen estadísticas oficiales.

fr.title: 3 000 arrestations par jour : comment un renforcement de la politique de l'ICE pèse sur la construction et la main-d'œuvre agricole

segments.src: ## A Sharper Enforcement Push Ripples Through the Job Site
segments.tr: ## Un renforcement des contrôles se fait sentir sur les chantiers

segments.src: Builders, farm operators and food processors across the country say they are feeling the effects of a stepped-up federal immigration enforcement effort that, according to multiple news reports, has pushed U.S.
segments.tr: Les constructeurs, exploitants agricoles et transformateurs alimentaires de tout le pays déclarent ressentir les effets d'une intensification des efforts fédéraux de contrôle de l'immigration qui, selon plusieurs reportages, a poussé les bureaux locaux de l'

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) field offices toward a steep increase in daily arrest targets — with some accounts citing a goal in the range of roughly 3,000 arrests per day nationwide.
segments.tr: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) à revoir nettement à la hausse leurs objectifs d'arrestations quotidiennes, certains rapports évoquant un objectif de l'ordre de 3 000 arrestations par jour à l'échelle nationale.

segments.src: The precise figures have not been independently verified by all outlets and vary depending on the source, but the broader trend described by employers, labor groups and immigration attorneys is consistent: worksite enforcement activity has intensified noticeably in 2026 compared with prior years.
segments.tr: Les chiffres précis n'ont pas été vérifiés de manière indépendante par tous les médias et varient selon la source, mais la tendance générale décrite par les employeurs, les groupes syndicaux et les avocats spécialisés en immigration est cohérente : l'activité de contrôle sur les lieux de travail s'est intensifiée de manière notable en 2026 par rapport aux années précédentes.

segments.src: For industries that have long relied on immigrant labor — construction, agriculture, meatpacking and food processing chief among them — the shift is being described less as a single dramatic event and more as a steady drain.
segments.tr: Pour les secteurs qui dépendent depuis longtemps de la main-d'œuvre immigrée — construction, agriculture, abattage et transformation alimentaire en tête —, ce changement est décrit moins comme un événement unique et dramatique que comme une hémorragie constante.

segments.src: Contractors report crews arriving short-handed.
segments.tr: Les entrepreneurs signalent des équipes qui arrivent en sous-effectif.

segments.src: Farm operators describe fields left unharvested.
segments.tr: Les exploitants agricoles décrivent des champs laissés non récoltés.

segments.src: Processing plants say they are running reduced shifts.
segments.tr: Les usines de transformation affirment tourner au ralenti avec des équipes réduites.

segments.src: None of this is easily reduced to a single headline number, but the cumulative effect on day-to-day operations is what business owners say concerns them most.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela ne se résume facilement à un chiffre unique dans un titre, mais l'effet cumulé sur les opérations quotidiennes est ce qui préoccupe le plus les propriétaires d'entreprise.

segments.src: ## Why Construction and Agriculture Are Especially Exposed
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la construction et l'agriculture sont particulièrement exposées

segments.src: Both sectors share a structural feature that makes them sensitive to enforcement swings: a workforce that is disproportionately foreign-born, including a share of workers without full legal work authorization.
segments.tr: Les deux secteurs partagent une caractéristique structurelle qui les rend sensibles aux variations des contrôles : une main-d'œuvre majoritairement née à l'étranger, comprenant une proportion de travailleurs ne disposant pas d'une autorisation de travail pleinement légale.

segments.src: Industry associations have noted for years that domestic labor supply alone has not kept pace with demand in framing crews, roofing, drywall, produce picking and poultry processing — jobs that are physically demanding, often seasonal, and historically difficult to staff at prevailing wages in many regions.
segments.tr: Les associations professionnelles soulignent depuis des années que l'offre de main-d'œuvre locale ne suffit pas à répondre à la demande pour la charpente, la couverture, la pose de cloisons sèches, la cueillette de fruits et légumes et la transformation de la volaille — des emplois physiquement exigeants, souvent saisonniers et historiquement difficiles à pourvoir aux salaires en vigueur dans de nombreuses régions.

segments.src: When enforcement activity rises at a job site or packing facility, the impact is rarely limited to the individuals directly affected.
segments.tr: Lorsque l'activité de contrôle augmente sur un chantier ou dans une usine de conditionnement, l'impact se limite rarement aux personnes directement concernées.

segments.src: Contractors describe having to pause projects to reassign work, renegotiate subcontracts, or slow timelines.
segments.tr: Les entrepreneurs décrivent devoir interrompre des projets pour réaffecter le travail, négocier à nouveau des sous-traitances ou ralentir les calendriers.

segments.src: Farm groups warn that a labor gap during a harvest window can mean crops left in the field, since produce cannot simply wait for a replacement crew the way other industries can absorb a delay.
segments.tr: Les groupes agricoles avertissent qu'un manque de main-d'œuvre pendant la période des récoltes peut signifier des cultures laissées dans les champs, car les produits ne peuvent pas simplement attendre une équipe de remplacement comme d'autres secteurs peuvent absorber un retard.

segments.src: ## Employers Caught Between Compliance and Continuity
segments.tr: ## Des employeurs pris entre conformité et continuité

segments.src: Business owners in both sectors emphasize that they are required to verify work eligibility through federal I-9 procedures and, in a growing number of states, E-Verify — and that responsible employers are not knowingly hiring unauthorized workers.
segments.tr: Les propriétaires d'entreprise des deux secteurs soulignent qu'ils sont tenus de vérifier l'éligibilité au travail par le biais des procédures fédérales I-9 et, dans un nombre croissant d'États, d'E-Verify, et que les employeurs responsables n'embauchent pas sciemment de travailleurs non autorisés.

segments.src: Industry representatives argue that the more urgent problem is a mismatch between the scale of enforcement and the absence of an expanded legal pathway for seasonal or year-round labor, leaving employers exposed to disruption regardless of how carefully they screen hires.
segments.tr: Les représentants de l'industrie soutiennent que le problème le plus urgent est le décalage entre l'ampleur des contrôles et l'absence de voies légales élargies pour la main-d'œuvre saisonnière ou annuelle, ce qui expose les employeurs aux perturbations, peu importe la minutie avec laquelle ils filtrent leurs embauches.

segments.src: Trade groups representing homebuilders and agricultural producers have renewed calls for Congress to address visa program capacity — including the H-2A program for agricultural workers and proposals to expand similar options for construction — arguing that enforcement without a corresponding labor supply fix simply shifts the shortage rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: Les associations professionnelles représentant les constructeurs de maisons et les producteurs agricoles ont renouvelé leurs appels au Congrès pour qu'il se penche sur la capacité des programmes de visas — y compris le programme H-2A pour les travailleurs agricoles et les propositions visant à élargir des options similaires pour la construction —, arguant qu'un contrôle sans correction correspondante de l'offre de main-d'œuvre ne fait que déplacer la pénurie au lieu de la résoudre.

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## Le coût humain et communautaire

segments.src: Immigration attorneys and worker advocacy organizations point to a separate set of concerns: due process for those detained, family separation when a primary earner is arrested, and the chilling effect on entire communities, where workers — including some with pending legal status applications — may stop showing up to job sites out of fear, regardless of their individual circumstances.
segments.tr: Les avocats spécialisés en immigration et les organisations de défense des travailleurs soulignent un autre ensemble de préoccupations : le respect des procédures régulières pour les personnes détenues, la séparation des familles lorsqu'un soutien de famille est arrêté, et l'effet dissuasif sur des communautés entières, où des travailleurs — y compris certains dont les demandes de statut légal sont en cours — peuvent cesser de se présenter sur les chantiers par peur, indépendamment de leur situation individuelle.

segments.src: Local officials in some heavily agricultural counties have said school attendance and small-business foot traffic have dipped in the aftermath of visible enforcement operations.
segments.tr: Des élus locaux de certains comtés à forte dominante agricole ont indiqué que la fréquentation scolaire et la circulation piétonne dans les petits commerces avaient chuté à la suite d'opérations de contrôle visibles.

segments.src: ## The Administration's Position
segments.tr: ## La position de l'administration

segments.src: Federal officials have defended intensified worksite enforcement as a matter of upholding existing immigration law and prioritizing the removal of individuals without legal status, framing it as consistent with directives issued earlier in the current administration's term.
segments.tr: Les responsables fédéraux ont défendu l'intensification des contrôles sur les lieux de travail au nom du respect de la législation sur l'immigration en vigueur et de la priorité donnée à l'expulsion des personnes en situation irrégulière, qualifiant cette démarche de cohérente avec les directives émises plus tôt dans le mandat de l'administration actuelle.

segments.src: Officials have generally not confirmed a specific numeric daily quota publicly, and characterizations of internal targets have come primarily through anonymous sourcing in press reports, congressional inquiries and statements from advocacy groups tracking enforcement data.
segments.tr: Les autorités n'ont généralement pas confirmé publiquement de quota quotidien chiffré précis, et les descriptions des objectifs internes proviennent principalement de sources anonymes dans les reportages de presse, d'enquêtes parlementaires et de déclarations de groupes de plaidoyer suivant les données relatives aux contrôles.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller

segments.src: Several dynamics will shape how this plays out in the months ahead:
segments.tr: Plusieurs dynamiques façonneront la suite des événements dans les mois à venir :

segments.src: - **Legislative response:** Whether Congress revisits agricultural or construction-specific visa reform amid industry pressure.
segments.tr: - **Réponse législative :** La question de savoir si le Congrès réexaminera la réforme des visas spécifiques à l'agriculture ou à la construction sous la pression de l'industrie.

segments.src: - **Regional variation:** Enforcement intensity has reportedly varied significantly by ICE field office and region, meaning the impact on labor supply is uneven across the country.
segments.tr: - **Variation régionale :** L'intensité des contrôles a apparemment varié de manière significative selon les bureaux régionaux de l'ICE et les régions, ce qui signifie que l'impact sur l'offre de main-d'œuvre est inpeuplé à travers le pays.

segments.src: - **Litigation:** Civil rights and immigration law organizations have signaled they may challenge specific enforcement actions on procedural grounds.
segments.tr: - **Contentieux :** Des organisations de défense des droits civiques et du droit des immigration ont indiqué qu'elles pourraient contester des actions de contrôle spécifiques pour des motifs de procédure.

segments.src: - **Price effects:** Economists are watching whether labor shortages in these sectors contribute to upward pressure on construction costs and food prices later in the year.
segments.tr: - **Effets sur les prix :** Les économistes surveillent si les pénuries de main-d'œuvre dans ces secteurs contribuent à une pression à la hausse sur les coûts de construction et les prix alimentaires plus tard dans l'année.

segments.src: As with most fast-moving policy stories, official figures, program details and enforcement priorities can shift quickly.
segments.tr: Comme pour la plupart des sujets politiques qui évoluent rapidement, les chiffres officiels, les détails des programmes et les priorités en matière de contrôle peuvent changer rapidement.

segments.src: Readers should treat specific numeric claims — including daily arrest targets — as reported estimates rather than confirmed government data until agencies release official statistics.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs doivent traiter les affirmations chiffrées spécifiques — y compris les objectifs d'arrestation quotidiens — comme des estimations rapportées plutôt que comme des données gouvernementales confirmées jusqu'à ce que les agences publient des statistiques officielles.

segments.tr: Asosiasi industri telah mencatat selama bertahun-tahun bahwa pasokan tenaga kerja domestik saja belum mengimbangi permintaan dalam kru pembingkaian, atap, drywall, pemetikan hasil bumi, dan pengolahan unggas — pekerjaan yang menuntut fisik, seringkali musiman, dan secara historis sulit untuk diisi dengan upah yang berlaku di banyak wilayah.

segments.src: When enforcement activity rises at a job site or packing facility, the impact is rarely limited to the individuals directly affected.
segments.tr: Ketika aktivitas penegakan hukum meningkat di lokasi kerja atau fasilitas pengemasan, dampaknya jarang terbatas pada individu yang terkena dampak langsung.

segments.src: Contractors describe having to pause projects to reassign work, renegotiate subcontracts, or slow timelines.
segments.tr: Kontraktor menggambarkan harus menghentikan proyek untuk menugaskan kembali pekerjaan, menegosiasikan ulang subkontrak, atau memperlambat jadwal.

segments.src: Farm groups warn that a labor gap during a harvest window can mean crops left in the field, since produce cannot simply wait for a replacement crew the way other industries can absorb a delay.
segments.tr: Kelompok pertanian memperingatkan bahwa kesenjangan tenaga kerja selama jendela panen dapat berarti tanaman tertinggal di ladang, karena hasil bumi tidak bisa begitu saja menunggu kru pengganti seperti industri lain yang dapat menyerap penundaan.

segments.src: ## Employers Caught Between Compliance and Continuity
segments.tr: ## Pemberi Kerja Terjepit Antara Kepatuhan dan Kontinuitas

segments.src: Business owners in both sectors emphasize that they are required to verify work eligibility through federal I-9 procedures and, in a growing number of states, E-Verify — and that responsible employers are not knowingly hiring unauthorized workers.
segments.tr: Pemilik bisnis di kedua sektor menekankan bahwa mereka diharuskan untuk memverifikasi kelayakan kerja melalui prosedur I-9 federal dan, di semakin banyak negara bagian, E-Verify — dan bahwa pemberi kerja yang bertanggung jawab tidak dengan sengaja mempekerjakan pekerja yang tidak sah.

segments.src: Industry representatives argue that the more urgent problem is a mismatch between the scale of enforcement and the absence of an expanded legal pathway for seasonal or year-round labor, leaving employers exposed to disruption regardless of how carefully they screen hires.
segments.tr: Perwakilan industri berpendapat bahwa masalah yang lebih mendesak adalah ketidaksesuaian antara skala penegakan hukum dan tidak adanya jalur hukum yang diperluas untuk tenaga kerja musiman atau sepanjang tahun, yang membuat pemberi kerja terpapar pada gangguan terlepas dari seberapa hati-hati mereka menyaring karyawan baru.

segments.src: Trade groups representing homebuilders and agricultural producers have renewed calls for Congress to address visa program capacity — including the H-2A program for agricultural workers and proposals to expand similar options for construction — arguing that enforcement without a corresponding labor supply fix simply shifts the shortage rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: Kelompok perdagangan yang mewakili pembangun rumah dan produsen pertanian telah memperbarui seruan agar Kongres menangani kapasitas program visa — termasuk program H-2A untuk pekerja pertanian dan proposal untuk memperluas opsi serupa untuk konstruksi — dengan alasan bahwa penegakan hukum tanpa perbaikan pasokan tenaga kerja yang sesuai hanya menggeser kekurangan alih-alih menyelesaikannya.

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## Dampak Kemanusiaan dan Komunitas

segments.src: Immigration attorneys and worker advocacy organizations point to a separate set of concerns: due process for those detained, family separation when a primary earner is arrested, and the chilling effect on entire communities, where workers — including some with pending legal status applications — may stop showing up to job sites out of fear, regardless of their individual circumstances.
segments.tr: Pengacara imigrasi dan organisasi advokasi pekerja menunjukkan serangkaian kekhawatiran terpisah: proses hukum bagi mereka yang ditahan, pemisahan keluarga ketika pencari nafkah utama ditangkap, dan efek mengerikan pada seluruh komunitas, di mana para pekerja — termasuk beberapa dengan aplikasi status hukum yang tertunda — mungkin berhenti muncul di lokasi kerja karena takut, terlepas dari keadaan individu mereka.

segments.src: Local officials in some heavily agricultural counties have said school attendance and small-business foot traffic have dipped in the aftermath of visible enforcement operations.
segments.tr: Pejabat lokal di beberapa daerah yang sangat agraris mengatakan kehadiran sekolah dan lalu lintas pejalan kaki di usaha kecil telah menurun setelah operasi penegakan hukum yang terlihat.

segments.src: ## The Administration's Position
segments.tr: ## Posisi Pemerintah

segments.src: Federal officials have defended intensified worksite enforcement as a matter of upholding existing immigration law and prioritizing the removal of individuals without legal status, framing it as consistent with directives issued earlier in the current administration's term.
segments.tr: Pejabat federal telah membela penegakan hukum di tempat kerja yang diintensifkan sebagai masalah menegakkan hukum imigrasi yang ada dan memprioritaskan pemindahan individu tanpa status hukum, membingkainya sebagai konsisten dengan arahan yang dikeluarkan sebelumnya dalam masa jabatan pemerintahan saat ini.

segments.src: Officials have generally not confirmed a specific numeric daily quota publicly, and characterizations of internal targets have come primarily through anonymous sourcing in press reports, congressional inquiries and statements from advocacy groups tracking enforcement data.
segments.tr: Pejabat umumnya belum mengonfirmasi kuota harian numerik tertentu secara publik, dan karakterisasi target internal terutama datang melalui sumber anonim dalam laporan pers, pertanyaan kongres, dan pernyataan dari kelompok advokasi yang melacak data penegakan hukum.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan Selanjutnya

segments.src: Several dynamics will shape how this plays out in the months ahead:
segments.tr: Beberapa dinamika akan membentuk bagaimana ini terjadi dalam beberapa bulan mendatang:

segments.src: - **Legislative response:** Whether Congress revisits agricultural or construction-specific visa reform amid industry pressure.
segments.tr: - **Tanggapan legislatif:** Apakah Kongres meninjau kembali reformasi visa khusus pertanian atau konstruksi di tengah tekanan industri.

segments.src: - **Regional variation:** Enforcement intensity has reportedly varied significantly by ICE field office and region, meaning the impact on labor supply is uneven across the country.
segments.tr: - **Variasi regional:** Intensitas penegakan hukum dilaporkan bervariasi secara signifikan menurut kantor lapangan ICE dan wilayah, yang berarti dampak pada pasokan tenaga kerja tidak merata di seluruh negeri.

segments.src: - **Litigation:** Civil rights and immigration law organizations have signaled they may challenge specific enforcement actions on procedural grounds.
segments.tr: - **Litigasi:** Organisasi hak sipil dan hukum imigrasi telah mengisyaratkan bahwa mereka mungkin menantang tindakan penegakan hukum tertentu atas dasar prosedural.

segments.src: - **Price effects:** Economists are watching whether labor shortages in these sectors contribute to upward pressure on construction costs and food prices later in the year.
segments.tr: - **Efek harga:** Ekonom sedang mengamati apakah kekurangan tenaga kerja di sektor-sektor ini berkontribusi pada tekanan kenaikan biaya konstruksi dan harga pangan di kemudian hari tahun ini.

segments.src: As with most fast-moving policy stories, official figures, program details and enforcement priorities can shift quickly.
segments.tr: Seperti kebanyakan berita kebijakan yang bergerak cepat, angka resmi, detail program, dan prioritas penegakan hukum dapat berubah dengan cepat.

segments.src: Readers should treat specific numeric claims — including daily arrest targets — as reported estimates rather than confirmed government data until agencies release official statistics.
segments.tr: Pembaca harus memperlakukan klaim numerik tertentu — termasuk target penangkapan harian — sebagai perkiraan yang dilaporkan daripada data pemerintah yang dikonfirmasi sampai lembaga merilis statistik resmi.

segments.src: ## A Sharper Enforcement Push Ripples Through the Job Site

segments.src: Builders, farm operators and food processors across the country say they are feeling the effects of a stepped-up federal immigration enforcement effort that, according to multiple news reports, has pushed U.S.
segments.tr: 全国の建設業者、農業経営者、食品加工業者は、複数の報道によると、米国の

segments.src: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) field offices toward a steep increase in daily arrest targets — with some accounts citing a goal in the range of roughly 3,000 arrests per day nationwide.
segments.tr: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)の地方事務所を日々の逮捕目標の急激な引き上げへと向かわせている、強化された連邦移民取り締まり活動の影響を感じていると述べている。一部の報道では、全国で1日あたり約3,000人の逮捕という目標が挙げられている。

segments.src: The precise figures have not been independently verified by all outlets and vary depending on the source, but the broader trend described by employers, labor groups and immigration attorneys is consistent: worksite enforcement activity has intensified noticeably in 2026 compared with prior years.
segments.tr: 正確な数値はすべてのメディアによって独自に検証されているわけではなく、情報源によって異なるが、雇用主、労働団体、移民弁護士によって説明されている全体的な傾向は一貫している。2026年には、職場での取り締まり活動が前年と比較して顕著に激化している。

segments.src: For industries that have long relied on immigrant labor — construction, agriculture, meatpacking and food processing chief among them — the shift is being described less as a single dramatic event and more as a steady drain.
segments.tr: 長年にわたり移民労働に依存してきた産業（建設業、農業、食肉加工、食品加工がその筆頭）にとって、この変化は単なる劇的な出来事というよりも、着実な流出として捉えられている。

segments.src: Contractors report crews arriving short-handed.
segments.tr: 請負業者は、人員不足の状態で現場に到着する作業員について報告している。

segments.src: Farm operators describe fields left unharvested.
segments.tr: 農業経営者は、収穫されずに残された畑を描写している。

segments.src: Processing plants say they are running reduced shifts.
segments.tr: 加工工場は、シフトを減らして稼働していると述べている。

segments.src: None of this is easily reduced to a single headline number, but the cumulative effect on day-to-day operations is what business owners say concerns them most.
segments.tr: これらはいずれも単一の見出しの数字に簡単に落とし込めるものではないが、日々の業務に対する累積的な影響こそが、事業主が最も懸念していることであると述べている。

segments.src: ## Why Construction and Agriculture Are Especially Exposed
segments.tr: ## なぜ建設業と農業が特に影響を受けるのか

segments.src: Both sectors share a structural feature that makes them sensitive to enforcement swings: a workforce that is disproportionately foreign-born, including a share of workers without full legal work authorization.
segments.tr: 両セクターには、取り締まりの変動に対して敏感になる構造的な特徴が共通してある。それは、完全な合法的な就労資格を持たない労働者を含め、外国生まれの労働者の割合が不釣り合いに高いという労働力である。

segments.src: Industry associations have noted for years that domestic labor supply alone has not kept pace with demand in framing crews, roofing, drywall, produce picking and poultry processing — jobs that are physically demanding, often seasonal, and historically difficult to staff at prevailing wages in many regions.
segments.tr: 業界団体は長年、国内の労働力供給だけでは、フレーミング（枠組み工事）、屋根葺き、乾式壁（ドライウォール）、農産物の収穫、鶏肉加工などにおける需要に追いついていないと指摘してきた。これらの仕事は肉体的に厳しく、しばしば季節労働であり、多くの地域で当時の賃金では人員確保が歴史的に困難なものである。

segments.src: When enforcement activity rises at a job site or packing facility, the impact is rarely limited to the individuals directly affected.
segments.tr: 現場や加工施設で取り締まり活動が活発化すると、その影響が直接影響を受ける個人にとどまることはめったにない。

segments.tr: 請負業者は、作業を再割り当てしたり、下請け契約を再交渉したり、スケジュールを遅らせるためにプロジェクトを一時停止しなければならないと説明している。

segments.src: Farm groups warn that a labor gap during a harvest window can mean crops left in the field, since produce cannot simply wait for a replacement crew the way other industries can absorb a delay.
segments.tr: 農地グループは、収穫期の労働力不足は畑に作物が放置されることを意味すると警告している。他の産業であれば遅延を吸収できるのとは異なり、農産物は代わりの作業員を単純に待つことができないからである。

segments.src: ## Employers Caught Between Compliance and Continuity
segments.tr: ## コンプライアンスと事業継続の間で板挟みになる雇用主

segments.src: Business owners in both sectors emphasize that they are required to verify work eligibility through federal I-9 procedures and, in a growing number of states, E-Verify — and that responsible employers are not knowingly hiring unauthorized workers.
segments.tr: 両セクターの事業主は、連邦のI-9手続きを通じて就労資格を確認することが義務付けられており、ますます多くの州でE-Verifyの導入が進んでいること、そして責任ある雇用主は無許可の労働者を故意に雇っているわけではないことを強調している。

segments.src: Industry representatives argue that the more urgent problem is a mismatch between the scale of enforcement and the absence of an expanded legal pathway for seasonal or year-round labor, leaving employers exposed to disruption regardless of how carefully they screen hires.
segments.tr: 業界の代表者らは、より緊急性の高い問題は、取り締まりの規模と、季節労働者や通年労働者のための拡大された法的経路の欠如との間の不一致であり、そのため雇用主は採用の審査をどれほど慎重に行おうとも混乱にさらされていると主張している。

segments.src: Trade groups representing homebuilders and agricultural producers have renewed calls for Congress to address visa program capacity — including the H-2A program for agricultural workers and proposals to expand similar options for construction — arguing that enforcement without a corresponding labor supply fix simply shifts the shortage rather than resolving it.
segments.tr: ホームビルダーや農業生産者を代表する業界団体は、議会に対してビザプログラムの容量に対処するよう改めて求めている。これには、農業労働者向けのH-2Aプログラムや建設業向けに同様の選択肢を拡大する提案が含まれており、対応する労働力供給の修正を伴わない取り締まりは、不足を解決するのではなく単にシフトさせるだけであると主張している。

segments.src: ## The Human and Community Toll
segments.tr: ## 人道的およびコミュニティへの代償

segments.src: Immigration attorneys and worker advocacy organizations point to a separate set of concerns: due process for those detained, family separation when a primary earner is arrested, and the chilling effect on entire communities, where workers — including some with pending legal status applications — may stop showing up to job sites out of fear, regardless of their individual circumstances.
segments.tr: 移民弁護士や労働者支援団体は、拘束された人々の適正手続、主要な稼ぎ手が逮捕された際の家族の離散、そして個々の状況に関係なく、法ステータスの申請が係属中の労働者を含め、労働者たちが恐怖から現場に姿を見せなくなるという、コミュニティ全体への萎縮効果という別の懸念事項を指摘している。

segments.src: Local officials in some heavily agricultural counties have said school attendance and small-business foot traffic have dipped in the aftermath of visible enforcement operations.
segments.tr: 農業が盛んな一部の郡の地元当局者は、目に見える取り締まり活動の余波を受けて、学校の出席率や小規模ビジネスの客足が低下したと述べている。
